c12_owner_site_review.early_july: ref/photos/juku-pcb-2/PXL_20260710_200402344.jpg native crop (2050,1290)-(2220,1640): the gap between the D94 blue socket and D100 package contains exposed front copper and an open via, with no vertical capacitor body at the factory-drawn centre

later_july_fitted_body.orientation: The raw 3072x4080 portrait image was rotated 90 degrees counterclockwise for inspection only; rotated crop (1950,280)-(2300,850) corresponds to raw portrait rectangle approximately (2221,1950)-(2791,2300).
later_july_fitted_body.observation: A green axial two-lead body occupies the factory C12 gap between the D94 blue socket and D100 КР580ВА87. Its upper bent lead reaches the front solder pool above D100's top-left package contact, which has continuous front copper to physical pin20/VCC. Its lower bent lead reaches the D94 socket's lower-right contact, physical pin8/GND. The package notches point left in the rotated view: DIP pin20 is upper-left on D100, and DIP pin8 is lower-right on D94. No component value is legible. The earlier May and 20:04 July views show the same exposed gap bare; the later 20:27 July view proves later population, not when or why the part was fitted.
later_july_fitted_body.classification: factory-position C12 identification and late-view +5 V/GND lead topology photo-supported; no power-off continuity measurement or value

local_three_hole_match.observation: The upper hole and the lower two-hole pair retain their geometry under cross-face reflection. All three are open/unfilled in both faces. This matches hole positions locally but does not identify any pair as C12 leads. Native solder crop (1450,1150)-(1760,1480) shows the upper hole's narrow B.Cu line heading east to another open hole near (1935,1215); the reflected lower-right hole at (1651,1403) descends to a westbound line; the lower-left hole at (1605,1403) has no visible B.Cu departure. Front copper and source rail identities remain unresolved.

c12_owner_site_review.limit: The bare-site claim applies only to the May and early-July snapshots. The later July photo identifies a fitted C12-position body and its visible +5 V/GND lap-lead paths, but gives no value, insertion history, or numbered through-hole C12 pad pair. The three matched open holes should not be treated as this part's landings. The old C12 endpoint seed in photo 200418174 is outside the upper-D94/D100 view and is not a valid physical C12 probe point.
